## Structs

### `VmafxContextConfig`

Context configuration. Initialise with VMAFX_CONTEXT_CONFIG_INIT. Size 32 bytes.

| Field | Type | Offset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `struct_size` | `uint32_t` | 0 | Size of this struct as the caller compiled it; set by the _INIT macro. |
| `log_level` | `uint32_t (`VmafxLogLevel`)` | 4 | Log verbosity. |
| `n_threads` | `uint32_t` | 8 | Worker threads; 0 runs extractors on the calling thread. |
| `n_subsample` | `uint32_t` | 12 | Score every n-th frame; 0 and 1 score every frame. |
| `cpumask` | `uint64_t` | 16 | CPU instruction-set bits to disable. |
| `gpumask` | `uint64_t` | 24 | GPU dispatch bits to disable. |

### `VmafxProvenance`

| `n_extractors` | `uint32_t` | 20 | Registered feature extractors; see vmafx_context_extractor_info(). |
| `version` | `const char *` | 24 | Build version (git describe). |

### `VmafxScore`

One score and the extractor that produced it. Size 40 bytes.

| Field | Type | Offset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `struct_size` | `uint32_t` | 0 | Size of this struct as the caller compiled it; set by the _INIT macro. |
| `backend` | `uint32_t (`VmafxBackend`)` | 4 | Backend of the producing extractor (CPU when none is registered). |
| `index` | `uint64_t` | 8 | Frame index. |
| `value` | `double` | 16 | Score. |
| `feature` | `const char *` | 24 | Feature name as requested. |
| `extractor` | `const char *` | 32 | Registered extractor that declares the feature, or NULL (imported scores, option-decorated names until WP5). |

## Status codes

| Code | Value | libvmaf errno | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VMAFX_OK` | 0 | `0` | Success. |
| `VMAFX_PENDING` | 1 | `-EAGAIN` | The requested score is not final yet (libvmaf returned -EAGAIN). |
| `VMAFX_E_INVALID` | -1 | `-EINVAL` | Invalid argument or state; the error names the parameter. |
| `VMAFX_E_NOMEM` | -2 | `-ENOMEM` | Out of memory. |
| `VMAFX_E_NOTSUP` | -3 | `-ENOTSUP` | Backend, format or option not supported; the error names it. |
| `VMAFX_E_NOTFOUND` | -4 | `-ENOENT` | Unknown feature, model, extractor index or device. |
| `VMAFX_E_BUSY` | -5 | `-EBUSY` | Resource already in use. |
| `VMAFX_E_DEVICE` | -6 | `-EIO` | Backend runtime failure; the error carries the runtime's code. |
| `VMAFX_E_IO` | -7 | `-EIO` | File or stream error. |
| `VMAFX_E_RANGE` | -8 | `-ERANGE` | Value out of range. |
| `VMAFX_E_INTERNAL` | -9 | `-EIO` | Engine error without a more specific status; the error carries the engine's errno. |
